title: Finite-state DP is exact for LRU miss distributions on fixed-frequency traces
author: research-lead (model-assisted)
model_assumptions: The trace is a uniformly random distinct permutation of a fixed multiset with counts n_i and total N.
The cache is ideal LRU with capacity k >= 1 and starts empty.
The state is (remaining counts, cache contents ordered LRU to MRU).
The recurrence conditions on the next label with probability remaining_i / remaining_total.
claim: The finite-state recurrence in research/theory/lru-multiset-exact.md yields the exact miss-count distribution, and its expectation and distribution match independent exhaustive enumeration on every checked instance with at most three labels, seven accesses and capacity at most three.
proof_notes: The recurrence follows from the law of total probability and an exact LRU update. The implementation was compared against a separately written brute-force enumerator using exact rational arithmetic on 45 count vectors and three capacities.
numerical_checks: 45 count vectors x capacities 1,2,3: DP distribution equals brute-force distribution exactly.
Capacity-one formula equals DP expectation on every vector.
Four labeled posets: every linear extension enumerated for the DAG examples.
prior_art: Finite-state Markov and LRU analyses are classical; this record claims no novelty.
unresolved_obligations: A general proof of the recurrence is straightforward but has not been independently audited as a theorem.
Literature review for prior exact DP formulations is incomplete.

review.notes: No independent or human review yet.

limitations: Finite instances only; state growth limits large traces.
No connection to measured cache behavior is established.
next_action: Use the exact model as an offline baseline; do not present it as an LLVM predictor.
